description: Facts recorded with brain_remember and when each was true. By default, the facts true now. `as_of` returns the facts true at another time (a bare date means the end of that day); `history` lists every version, oldest first, with what replaced it or when it expired; `subject` narrows to one thing, e.g. a project; `query` filters by words. The ids are the ones brain_remember's `replaces` takes.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (UTC). Default: now.

history.description: Every version, including replaced, expired and not-yet-valid facts

subject.description: Only facts recorded with this subject, e.g. 'JobMail'

name: brain_facts
title: Facts and how they changed
